args: ({ move, powerMult, accMult, instantCharge }) => { if (move.id === MoveId.WEATHER_BALL) { powerMult.value *= 2; return; } if (move.hasAttr("BlizzardAccuracyAttr")) { accMult.value = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY; } if (move.hasAttr("AntiSunlightPowerDecreaseAttr")) { powerMult.value *= 0.5; } if (move.isChargingMove() && move.getChargeAttrs("WeatherInstantChargeAttr").some(attr => attr.weatherTypes.includes(WeatherType.SNOW))) { instantCharge.value = true; } }
